name: Reinforced hydroelectric turbine
status: Installed; native high-head main 100 and fresh-process reload 101 passed. Two wet outlet cells, 3 m³/s total and 40,000 hp maximum (9,600 hp when tested). Extended hydraulics and pump-loop balance pending.
description: A reinforced outlet through a dam. Set its discharge in m³/s; actual forward flow and water head generate hp. Close it manually or with native automation. Build stairs to the service terrace and structures on the solid upper cap.
balanceStatus: ratedHp is the maximum, at maxDischarge and maxGeneratingHead; each lane makes ratedHp / (maxDischarge x maxGeneratingHead) = 833.33 hp per m³/s per layer of head (200 before the 2026-10-29 buff from 9,600 to 40,000 hp; discharge and head limits unchanged): 37,500 hp at 3 m³/s combined discharge and 15 layers of upstream-to-downstream head; 40,000 hp maximum at 16 layers. Each water lane receives half the total discharge limit. The requested coefficient exceeds the idealized Timber Pipes pump energy bound; actual dependency pump-loop balance remains unresolved.
